name: sdlc-graph
description: The SDLC as a guarded graph, with the milestone loop delegated to a milestone agent per milestone (per worktree under strategy C) whose bundle the orchestrator verifies against git before recording it. A run is one gitignored directory — state, per-milestone journals, and with --trace every state it passed through. Ships a run reviewer that turns a finished run into the evals it should have had, and an advisory onboarding skill that reports which optional tools this session can invoke and what a run does without each. Command-invoked.
